title: does anyone else have an elevator that only goes up?
content: For me its at the end of one side of the hallways inside the hotels and sometimes in the apartment buildings. It's always that I don't want to get into the elevator because its "out of order" but I'll be chased into the elevator down the hallways. Once you get into the clear glass elevator no matter what buttons you press it just shoots up all the way to the top and it keeps you there until either 1) someone comes to get you out, 2) someone inside the elevator with you somehow knows exactly how to fix it OR 3) the elevator keeps going through the ceiling and you fall onto the amusement park.
